title: Document mailbox route-miss 404 and its bounded diagnostics history
outcome: The mailbox docs explain both the public native_mailbox_route_miss error and nativeRouteMisses on the existing read-only diagnostics route, with its scope, safe fields, retained history limit and reset behavior.
acceptance: The mailbox feature documentation and architecture endpoint reference explain the new code and diagnostic section.
The documented code means a domain 404 after an observed native membership lookup miss, with no claim that the downstream 404 proves a particular cause or operation outcome.
The docs describe bounded process-local retention, caller and mailbox identity, store and server identity, and omission of bodies and receipts.
